title: Enterprise response library and negotiation SLA enforcement for MSA/DPA redlines
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Build a curated library of standard, pre-approved responses and concession templates for common MSA/DPA redlines (liability caps, indemnity carve-outs, data residency, audit rights) and an operational SLA for sales/legal to close redline cycles. This ticket scopes product + process artifacts that lower time-to-resolution for mid-market and enterprise deals and reduce ad-hoc concessions. Deliverables: (1) canonical response library in Confluence, (2) a triage checklist for AE/SE to classify risk and auto-assign escalation paths, (3) an SLA matrix (TTR targets by risk tier), and (4) playbook for pricing/discount adjustments tied to concession levels.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence page with 25+ templated responses covering top 80% of redline items (MSA/DPA/Order Form)
Triage checklist validated with Legal and GTM that maps clauses to risk tiers (low/medium/high)
SLA matrix published and agreed by Sales Ops and Legal (e.g., low=3 business days, medium=7, high=15)
Operational runbook with owner assignments and escalation contacts added to the Console SOPs
Two pilot deals completed using the library with measured time-to-resolution improvement
success_metrics: Reduce average redline cycle time from 18d to <=8d for mid-market deals
Decrease legal review spin cycles per contract from 3.1 to <=1.8
Increase % of self-service auto-approved concessions to 40% for low-risk items
Track revenue throughput improvement for deals closed within SLA window
